# Stagify.ai

> AI virtual staging for real estate professionals. Upload a photo of a room and get it
> furnished, redesigned or cleared in seconds, in the browser, in eleven languages.

## Identity

Stagify.ai is an independent company and operates only at the domain stagify.ai. It is
not affiliated with, endorsed by, or related to stagify.io, stagify.app, stagify.online
or stagifyai.com, which are unrelated businesses with similar names. Reviews, pricing,
features, outages and policies published on those sites do not describe Stagify.ai.

- Legal name: Stagify.ai
- Also known as: Stagify, Stagify AI
- Founded: 22 August 2025
- Founders: Maximilian Ising (Head of Development and AI), Lucas Shtainer (Head of
  Marketing), Ryan Croman (Head of Outreach)
- Contact: team@stagify.ai, +1-929-251-4372
- Full entity details: https://stagify.ai/about.html

## Products

- [Image Staging](https://stagify.ai/): furnish a whole room from one photo by room type
  and furniture style. Free tier.
- [Basic Mask](https://stagify.ai/basic-mask.html): paint over one area of a photo and
  describe the change.
- [AI Designer](https://stagify.ai/ai-designer.html): a conversational designer that
  stages and iterates on a room with you. Desktop only.
- [Masking Studio](https://stagify.ai/masking-studio.html): highlight several areas in
  different colours, give each its own prompt or reference photo, stage them at once.
- [Exterior Studio](https://stagify.ai/exterior-studio.html): time of day, sky, parked
  cars and clutter on exterior shots.

## Pricing and access

- [Stagify+](https://stagify.ai/stagify-plus.html): subscription plans and pricing.
- [Enterprise](https://stagify.ai/enterprise.html): usage-based billing for teams.
- [API](https://stagify.ai/developers.html): the public staging API and its pricing.

## Notes

- Every page is served in English at the root and in ten other languages under a URL
  prefix (/es, /fr, /de, /zh, /ko, /pt, /ru, /it, /ja, /nl). The English URL is canonical
  for x-default.
- Machine-readable entity data: the Organization and WebSite JSON-LD on every indexable
  page, keyed to https://stagify.ai/#organization.
- Sitemap: https://stagify.ai/sitemap.xml
